name: side plank
description: A sideways plank balanced on one forearm. It builds strength in the obliques and the muscles that stabilise your trunk.
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your hips high and your neck neutral.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Don't let your hips drop or roll forward.
